marks.label: The growth chart
marks.sub: The WHO growth charts for weight, length and head size, from birth to 2 years.

marks.label: Look up any age
marks.sub: Pick an age and a percentile to see the value. No measurements needed.

marks.label: Point at the chart
marks.sub: Read the age, value and percentile anywhere, with the lines just above and below it.

marks.label: Pin a point
marks.sub: Click where your baby might be, then drag it to adjust.

marks.label: Same percentile
marks.sub: The dashed line shows where they would be if they stayed on the same percentile.

marks.label: Saved
marks.sub: It becomes your baby’s measurement, kept only in this browser.

marks.label: Add measurements
marks.sub: Enter the numbers from a checkup. Each one gets its percentile.
